name: Emoji'd
tagline: Type :shortcodes: in chat and see full-colour emoji.
description: Emoji'd is a client-side mod that turns Discord-style `:shortcodes:` in chat into full-colour emoji. Type `:sob:` and see 😭. It works on any server, because only your own display is rewritten and the message sent is unchanged. Emoji sent by other players as raw unicode are rendered too.

list: 1,870 emoji with 1,900+ Discord-style shortcodes, drawn in full colour with Twemoji
Fast typers can skip the underscores: `:faceholdingbacktears:` works like `:face_holding_back_tears:`
Works on any server and needs no server-side install
Chat history keeps the original text, so copying and logs still show `:sob:`

description: Requires Fabric Loader and Java 21 (Minecraft 1.21.11) or Java 25 (Minecraft 26.x).
